favourite.heading: Why Mississippi State can pull away
bullets: Playing at Mississippi State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Run offense: Mississippi State 70.2 (#4 of 136) vs Missouri 49.0 (#74 of 136) — 70 places on the national board.
Offense: Mississippi State 64.5 (#3 of 136) vs Missouri 51.9 (#51 of 136) — 48 places on the national board.
Kicking: Mississippi State 57.5 (#12 of 136) vs Missouri 56.5 (#55 of 136) — 43 places on the national board.

underdog.heading: Why Missouri can keep it close
bullets: Missouri is the better football team by 1.2 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-1.2 pts).
Linebackers: Missouri 57.7 (#16 of 136) vs Mississippi State 50.8 (#95 of 136) — 79 places on the national board.
Offensive line: Missouri 53.5 (#45 of 136) vs Mississippi State 45.6 (#115 of 136) — 70 places on the national board.
Defensive line: Missouri 59.2 (#13 of 136) vs Mississippi State 51.4 (#83 of 136) — 70 places on the national board.
The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 -20.1 to p90 +23.9 for Mississippi State, so a projection of +2.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
